Welcome back! Today: a $2 trillion number nobody will confirm, 100 billion new sources for ChatGPT, agents with trading access and code review moving into a group chat.  In today's Atlas Newsletter: What's Anthropic actually worth? It could file this month and beat SpaceX's $86.2 billion record, on $11.5 billion in quarterly revenue and a $42 billion loss last year. Where do your agent's answers come from? OpenAI's Exa plugin opens 100 billion websites, papers and companies to ChatGPT Work and Codex in about a minute. Would you let an agent place your trades? Binance connected Claude, ChatGPT and Codex to the exchange, with trading scopes and no withdrawal access. Who approves the code now? Slack Code puts agents, diffs and live previews inside a channel, free on every plan. PS: Want to collaborate with the biggest GTM engine and distribution moat for AI companies? You can feature your tool with us and reach millions. Anthropic is going for the biggest IPO in history  Anthropic could file publicly as soon as the end of this month, and it expects to match or beat the record SpaceX set in June, according to Bloomberg. That record is $75 billion raised, $86.2 billion once the overallotment landed.  Investors are floating a $2 trillion valuation, a figure CFO Krishna Rao declined to engage with in recent briefings. The revenue explains the nerve. Second-quarter revenue topped $11.5 billion against $787 million a year earlier, and the run rate hit $65 billion by late July. The same company lost roughly $42 billion in 2025.  Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan lined up to run the deal anyway. Ahead of the filing, Anthropic is finalizing a revolving credit facility expected to come in above its roughly $10 billion target.  Dario Amodei and his co-founders are weighing super-voting shares to keep control after listing. Claude's maker reaches the public market well before OpenAI, which pushed its own listing to 2027. The fastest way to answer a security questionnaire? Don't touch it. No matter your size, Vanta helps you automate compliance, manage risk, and prove trust continuously, all from a single agentic platform. 77664.subject: Online check-in for a smooth take-off. ATTENTION! Don’t forget – it opens 24 hours before departure. (Y9SB5U)
77664.body:
Hello, Oleh Novosadov!

Your adventure is just around the corner – you’ll soon be boarding your Ryanair flight! There’s just one small step left to ensure a smooth start: online check-in.

It’s easy – do it via the Ryanair app. This way, you avoid unnecessary fees at the airport..

How to do it? Here’s a quick guide:

You will need:
- Booking code: Y9SB5U
- Booking email: novosadov@boarding.sk (it may differ from your personal email address)

If you’re using the Ryanair mobile app, you can check in directly there – it’s fast, convenient and eco-friendly.

When is check-in available?
- From 24 to 2 hours before departure
- If you’ve purchased seats, you can check in as early as 60 days before your flight

Download your boarding passes.

Save them in the app – you’ll need them when going through airport security. Before your trip, make sure your BOARDING PASSES (tickets) are in ELECTRONIC FORM. Download them to your phone.

You’ll find a full step-by-step guide with screenshots in our manual for checking in online via the Ryanair app.

ATTENTION! If you leave the check-in until the airport, it may cost you up to €55.

That’s a lot of money you could use for your next Pelikan adventure instead! Check our calendar of promotional flights and start planning your next trip right now!

Yours faithfully
